interfaces.description:
List of ATM PVC interfaces to configure; each item defines one nasX interface bound to a PVC. One per line in the config file. Order matters: -c must precede -a, and options may follow in any order after PVC spec per br2684ctl(8). Each interface must include at least `number` and `pvc` fields. Optional fields override defaults (encapsulation=0, payload=1, send_buffer=8192, background=false). See NOTES below for defaults and constraints.

NOTES: - The `pvc` string must match `<itf>.<vpi>.<vci>` (e.g., "0.401").
- The `number` is an integer (0, 1, ...).
- The `encapsulation` must be 0 (LLC) or 1 (VC-mux).
- The `payload` must be 0 (Routed) or 1 (Bridged).
- The `send_buffer` must be a positive integer (default 8192).
- The `background` flag runs the process in the background (-b).

interfaces.pvc.description: ATM PVC identifier in format `<itf>.<vpi>.<vci>`, e.g. "0.401". Required.

interfaces.background.description: Run the process in the background (-b flag).
